# @unifycss/postcss **Official PostCSS plugin for UnifyCSS — integrates seamlessly into any CSS build pipeline.** [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@unifycss/postcss.svg?style=flat-square)](https://npmjs.com/package/@unifycss/postcss) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dw/@unifycss/postcss.svg?style=flat-square)](https://npmjs.com/package/@unifycss/postcss) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg?style=flat-square)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
--- ## Table of Contents - [Installation](#installation) - [Quick Start](#quick-start) - [Configuration File](#configuration-file) - [Framework Setup Guides](#framework-setup-guides) - [Vite + PostCSS](#vite--postcss) - [Create React App](#create-react-app) - [Next.js + PostCSS](#nextjs--postcss) - [Vue CLI / Nuxt](#vue-cli--nuxt) - [Angular](#angular) - [SvelteKit](#sveltekit) - [Parcel](#parcel) - [Plain Node.js build script](#plain-nodejs-build-script) - [Plugin Options Reference](#plugin-options-reference) - [CSS Purging](#css-purging) - [License](#license) --- ## Installation ```bash npm install @unifycss/postcss @unifycss/core -D # or pnpm add @unifycss/postcss @unifycss/core -D # or yarn add @unifycss/postcss @unifycss/core -D ``` --- ## Quick Start Create or update `postcss.config.mjs` in your project root: ```js // postcss.config.mjs export default { plugins: { '@unifycss/postcss': { configPath: './unifycss.config.js', }, autoprefixer: {}, ...(process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? { cssnano: {} } : {}), }, }; ``` Then create `unifycss.config.js`: ```js // unifycss.config.js /** @type {import('@unifycss/core').Config} */ export default { content: [ './src/**/*.{html,js,ts,jsx,tsx,vue,svelte}', ], }; ``` Then import UnifyCSS in your main CSS file: ```css /* src/index.css */ @import '@unifycss/unifycss/unifycss.css'; /* Your custom styles below */ :root { --brand-primary: #7c3aed; } ``` --- ## Configuration File ```js // unifycss.config.js /** @type {import('@unifycss/core').Config} */ export default { // Glob patterns for files to scan for class names content: [ './src/**/*.{html,js,ts,jsx,tsx,vue,svelte}', './public/**/*.html', ], // Safelist: always include these classes regardless of scanning safelist: [ 'btn-primary', 'btn-danger', 'alert-success', 'alert-danger', /^badge-/, // All badge-* classes ], // Theme token overrides theme: { extend: { colors: { brand: { primary: '#7c3aed' }, }, }, }, // Production CSS purging purge: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production', // Verbose logging during build verbose: false, }; ``` --- ## Framework Setup Guides ### Vite + PostCSS ```bash npm install -D @unifycss/postcss autoprefixer ``` ```js // postcss.config.mjs export default { plugins: { '@unifycss/postcss': { configPath: './unifycss.config.js' }, autoprefixer: {}, }, }; ``` ```ts // vite.config.ts — PostCSS is auto-detected from postcss.config.mjs import { defineConfig } from 'vite'; import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'; export default defineConfig({ plugins: [react()], }); ``` ```ts // src/main.ts import '@unifycss/unifycss/unifycss.css'; import './index.css'; ``` --- ### Create React App ```bash npm install -D @unifycss/postcss @unifycss/core ``` ```js // postcss.config.js (CJS format for CRA) module.exports = { plugins: { '@unifycss/postcss': { configPath: './unifycss.config.js' }, autoprefixer: {}, }, }; ``` --- ### Next.js + PostCSS ```js // postcss.config.mjs export default { plugins: { '@unifycss/postcss': { configPath: './unifycss.config.js' }, autoprefixer: {}, }, }; ``` ```tsx // app/layout.tsx import '@unifycss/unifycss/unifycss.css'; ``` > **Note:** For Next.js, you can also use `@unifycss/nextjs` instead which requires zero PostCSS configuration. --- ### Vue CLI / Nuxt ```js // postcss.config.cjs module.exports = { plugins: { '@unifycss/postcss': { configPath: './unifycss.config.js' }, autoprefixer: {}, }, }; ``` ```ts // src/main.ts import '@unifycss/unifycss/unifycss.css'; ``` For Nuxt 3, configure in `nuxt.config.ts`: ```ts // nuxt.config.ts export default defineNuxtConfig({ css: ['@unifycss/unifycss/unifycss.css'], postcss: { plugins: { '@unifycss/postcss': { configPath: './unifycss.config.js' }, autoprefixer: {}, }, }, }); ``` --- ### Angular ```bash npm install -D @unifycss/postcss @unifycss/core ``` ```js // postcss.config.js module.exports = { plugins: { '@unifycss/postcss': { configPath: './unifycss.config.js' }, autoprefixer: {}, }, }; ``` ```json // angular.json — add to styles array { "styles": [ "node_modules/@unifycss/unifycss/unifycss.css", "src/styles.css" ] } ``` --- ### SvelteKit ```js // postcss.config.mjs export default { plugins: { '@unifycss/postcss': { configPath: './unifycss.config.js' }, autoprefixer: {}, }, }; ``` ```ts // src/routes/+layout.ts import '@unifycss/unifycss/unifycss.css'; ``` --- ### Parcel No config file needed — Parcel auto-detects PostCSS configuration: ```bash npm install -D @unifycss/postcss autoprefixer ``` ```js // .postcssrc.mjs export default { plugins: { '@unifycss/postcss': { configPath: './unifycss.config.js' }, autoprefixer: {}, }, }; ``` --- ### Plain Node.js build script ```js // scripts/build-css.js import postcss from 'postcss'; import unifycss from '@unifycss/postcss'; import autoprefixer from 'autoprefixer'; import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'fs'; const input = readFileSync('./src/index.css', 'utf8'); const result = await postcss([ unifycss({ configPath: './unifycss.config.js' }), autoprefixer(), ]).process(input, { from: './src/index.css', to: './dist/output.css' }); writeFileSync('./dist/output.css', result.css); console.log('CSS built successfully.'); ``` --- ## Plugin Options Reference | Option | Type | Default | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `configPath` | `string` | `'./unifycss.config.js'` | Path to your UnifyCSS config file | | `content` | `string[]` | Config file value | Override glob patterns for class scanning | | `purge` | `boolean` | `true` in production | Enable tree-shaking purge of unused CSS classes | | `safelist` | `(string \| RegExp)[]` | `[]` | Class names or regex patterns to always preserve in output | | `blocklist` | `(string \| RegExp)[]` | `[]` | Class names or regex patterns to explicitly remove | | `stats` | `boolean` | `true` | Log terminal purge stats (initial vs purged size, reduction %) | | `verbose` | `boolean` | `false` | Log detailed class detection during builds | --- ## CSS Purging In production, `@unifycss/postcss` removes any CSS class that is not detected in your source files. **Classes are preserved if:** - They appear in any file matching the `content` glob patterns. - They are listed in the `safelist` option. - They are base styles (`:root`, `html`, `body`, `*`). **Dynamically constructed class names** should be safelisted: ```js // Dynamic classes like `badge-${color}` must be safelisted: export default { safelist: [ 'badge-success', 'badge-warning', 'badge-danger', 'badge-info', /^btn-/, // Safelist all btn-* variants /^alert-/, // Safelist all alert-* variants ], }; ``` --- ## License MIT © [UnifyCSS Team](https://unifycss.dev)
